name: STIHL MSA 70 C-B
blurb: Battery saw. One bar in STIHL's 2025 chart: 12″, 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge, 64 drive links (71 PM3 64).
intro: The STIHL MSA 70 C-B is a battery saw. STIHL's 2025 battery chart lists one loop: 12″ bar, 1/4″ PICCO Micro Mini, .043″ gauge, 64 drive links, chain 71 PM3 64, recommended bar 3005 008 3405. The specification table (catalog p. 64) agrees on a 12″ bar and 1/4″ P PM3. STIHL's file table lists 1/8″ (3.2 mm) for 1/4″ PICCO.

bars.note: STIHL's 2025 battery chart lists chain 71 PM3 64 with recommended bar 3005 008 3405. 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge, 12″ bar, sprocket nose R with 8 teeth. The marketing number starts with 71: the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel defines 7 as 1/4″ PICCO and 1 as .043″. STIHL's file table lists a 3.2 mm (1/8″) file for 1/4″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: specification tables (catalog pp. 64–67, specifications as of 1 October 2024) and the guide-bar drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167), including the file table and the PMM3/PM3 chain-type rows

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, battery guide-bar chart (catalog p. 167) and specification table (catalog p. 64, as of 1 October 2024), read 7 Nov 2026. File size from the catalog file table: 1/8″ for 1/4″ PICCO.
